question.text: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>300</mn><mo> </mo><mi>calories</mi></math> of heat is given to a heat engine, and it rejects <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>225</mn><mo> </mo><mi>calories</mi></math> of heat. If source temperature is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>227</mn><mo>°</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></math>, then the temperature of sink will be _____ <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mmultiscripts><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mprescripts></mprescripts><none></none><mo>∘</mo></mmultiscripts><mo>.</mo></math>

solution.text:
Efficiency of Carnot engine is given by η=1-Q2Q1=1-T2T1.

⇒1-225300=1-T2500

T2=53×225=375 K

So, temperature of sink is T2=375-273=102°C
